description: Guards for a git working tree shared by more than one CLAUDE CODE session. Registers this session in <git-common-dir>/claude-sessions/ at SessionStart, removes it at SessionEnd, and - only while another live Claude Code session shares this same working tree - guards the shared index against a commit that would carry their staged work, and the tree against a checkout/restore/reset that would overwrite their uncommitted changes. It only sees sessions that register, which means Claude Code sessions with this plugin loaded.
